review.message: apply_discount uses `total > 100` instead of `total >= 100`, so a total of exactly 100 does not receive the required 10% discount.
paginate returns `size + 1` items (`items[start:start + size + 1]`), violating the requirement to return at most `size` items.
apply_discount uses `total > 100`, so a total of exactly 100 does not get the 10% discount. The rule requires 10% off for totals of AT LEAST 100, so the boundary should be inclusive.
paginate slices `items[start:start + size + 1]`, which can return up to size + 1 items. The rule requires paginate to return AT MOST `size` items for the given page.
paginate returns items[start:start+size+1], which can yield size+1 items, violating the rule to return AT MOST size items.
apply_discount discounts only totals strictly greater than 100, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of AT LEAST 100.
parse_age does not raise ValueError for negative ages as required; int(text) accepts negative input.
paginate(items, page, size) returns `size + 1` items (slice `start:start + size + 1`), violating the rule that it returns AT MOST `size` items.
apply_discount(total) uses `total > 100`, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of AT LEAST 100, so a total of exactly 100 incorrectly receives no discount.
parse_age(text) converts to int and returns without checking, so it never raises ValueError for negative ages as required.
paginate returns size + 1 items instead of at most size.
apply_discount requires total > 100 instead of >= 100, so a total of exactly 100 does not get the discount.
parse_age does not raise ValueError for negative ages.
paginate(items, page, size) returns up to `size + 1` items because the slice end is `start + size + 1`. The rule requires AT MOST `size` items for the given page.
apply_discount(total) uses `total > 100`, so a total of exactly 100 does not receive the 10% discount. The rule requires the discount for totals of AT LEAST 100 (i.e. `>= 100`).
parse_age(text) does not raise ValueError for negative ages; `int('-5')` returns -5 and is returned without validation. The rule requires ValueError for negative ages.
